correctness.rationale: An idempotent total weak endomorphism of connected K_(a,b) fixes every image point. If its image is in one independent side it must be a constant map, giving a+b rank-one maps. With i,j>0 fixed image points on both sides, at least two fixed points in an opposite side force each source point to stay on its own side. Counting free images in four exhaustive cases (i=j=1, one image side singleton, or both sizes>=2) yields rho(i,j) and full rank polynomial for all a,b>=1. Subtract side-preserving idempotent transformations I_m^2 to obtain exact Delta_m; optimizing (m-i)log i and a matching lower summand gives log I_m and log Delta_m = m log m-m log log m+O(m), yielding the displayed logarithmic crossing probability. Independent exhaustive total-map enumeration for seven small bicliques reproduced rank histograms.

The logarithmic asymptotic has O(m) remainder only, no prefactor or unbalanced growth claimed.
